versions.changelog:
- Initial release for diagnosing and troubleshooting Alibaba Cloud NAS mount failures.
- Supports NFS and SMB protocol issues on both Linux and Windows, covering General Purpose and Extreme NAS types.
- Handles diagnosis of common mount errors, network/connectivity issues, permissions, security group and error code analysis (including Windows error codes).
- Supports special scenarios: container (K8s/Docker) NAS mounts, cross-VPC/cross-account issues, ECS Cloud Assistant batch mount failures.
- Includes step-by-step workflow: user info collection, pre-checks, error pattern quick diagnosis, and scenario-based troubleshooting.
- Read-only operation; no write actions performed—follows best practices for RAM permissions and session-based CLI usage.
